description: This file contains various query functions for searching and retrieving data related to ERPNext entities such as Employees, Leads, Customers, Suppliers, Items, BOMs, Projects, Delivery Notes, Batches, Accounts, and related entities. It includes functions decorated with frappe.whitelist for external access, utilizing SQL queries and metadata to perform filtered searches.

methods.name: employee_query
methods.description: Searches for active or suspended employees based on input filters and search text.

methods.name: lead_query
methods.description: Searches for leads that are not converted based on input filters and search text.

methods.name: customer_query
methods.description: Searches for customers based on user default settings and input filters.

methods.name: supplier_query
methods.description: Searches for suppliers based on user default settings and input filters.

methods.name: tax_account_query
methods.description: Retrieves tax accounts matching search text, filtered by company and account type.

methods.name: item_query
methods.description: Searches for items with optional filters, including description and barcode, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: bom
methods.description: Searches for Bill of Materials entries matching search text.

methods.name: get_project_name
methods.description: Retrieves project names filtered by customer and search text.

methods.name: get_delivery_notes_to_be_billed
methods.description: Fetches delivery notes pending billing based on filters.

methods.name: get_batch_no
methods.description: Retrieves batch numbers filtered by item, warehouse, and posting date.

methods.name: get_account_list
methods.description: Fetches list of accounts with optional search text and filters.

methods.name: get_blanket_orders
methods.description: Retrieves blanket orders filtered by item, type, and company.

methods.name: get_income_account
methods.description: Fetches income accounts filtered by company and search text.

methods.name: get_filtered_dimensions
methods.description: Retrieves filtered accounting dimensions based on filters and metadata.

methods.name: get_expense_account
methods.description: Fetches expense accounts filtered by company and search text.

methods.name: warehouse_query
methods.description: Searches for warehouses with stock quantities, filtered by item and other filters.

methods.name: get_batch_numbers
methods.description: Retrieves batch IDs filtered by item, expiry date, and other filters.

methods.name: item_manufacturer_query
methods.description: Searches for item manufacturers based on search text and item code.

methods.name: get_purchase_receipts
methods.description: Fetches purchase receipts filtered by item code.

methods.name: get_purchase_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves purchase invoices filtered by item code.

methods.name: get_tax_template
methods.description: Retrieves applicable tax templates for an item, considering item and item group taxes.

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Returns unique list of fields for a given doctype, including search fields and title field.
